title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately, you will not be unbanned at the moment. If you can provide proof that your ban is false (video), then your appeal may be considered. Since your ban is very recent, you will have to serve a significant amount of time being banned unless you have proof that your ban is false.

Regards,

Vacuum, Avicus Network Administrator.
